symptom: MDL-RETRIEVE02's own suggested rewrite `retrieve $Owner from System.User where [id = $Order/System.owner] first;` passed `check -p` and exec, then mxbuild failed `[CE0161] "Error(s) in XPath constraint." at Retrieve object(s) activity 'Retrieve User from database'` — whenever $Order's entity stores no owner (11.12.5). #641's `[System.owner = '[%CurrentUser%]']` on an entity declared in the same script passed the same way
cause: Nothing typed a VARIABLE in a constraint: #641's rule judged System.owner only on the retrieved entity, and only for a STORED entity (`ent == nil -> continue`), so the ordinary one-script shape (entity + microflow) was never judged
file: `mdl/executor/validate_retrieve_system_member_path.go` (wired beside validateRetrieveOperandTypes for microflows and nanoflows), `mdl/executor/validate.go` (`scriptSystemMemberRoot`, `systemMemberStoreFix`, validateRetrieveConstraints takes sc), `mdl/executor/flow_object_types.go` (MDL-SET01's variable typing, extracted), MDL-RETRIEVE02 suggestion names the precondition
insight: A rule's SUGGESTION is a code path too: MDL-RETRIEVE02's rewrite was measured clean on an entity that stores owner and its precondition never measured — run a suggested rewrite through the inverse case before shipping it. Measured matrix (11.12.5): `[id = $o/System.owner|changedBy]` is clean iff the generalization ROOT stores the member (own entity, FileDocument specialization, specialization of an owning root), CE0161 otherwise (plain entity, its specialization, a `create`-bound variable). An entity the script ALTERS must be unknown, not 'does not store': `alter entity X add attribute owner: AutoOwner` is exactly what the user does after reading the message, and it builds clean. Point the fix at the root (`alter entity <root> …`) — the specialization refuses Auto* members
